Statutory obligation / exposure risk: Unlawful processing of personal voter phone numbers carries fines up to Ksh 5,000,000 or 2 years jail.
Campaign risk mitigation protocol: Campaign registered with the ODPC as a Data Controller; all voter phone numbers sourced via opt-in barazas; mandatory "STOP" SMS opt-out.

Statutory obligation / exposure risk: Voter bribery, distribution of cash or free merchandise at rallies is an electoral offence causing candidate disqualification and 5-year jail.
Campaign risk mitigation protocol: Strict prohibition of direct cash handouts at rallies; all logistics payments to agents made via audited M-Pesa bulk business disbursements.

Statutory obligation / exposure risk: All campaign advertising, broadcasts and public rallies must cease 48 hours prior to polling station opening.
Campaign risk mitigation protocol: All radio spots, SMS engines and sound caravans terminate exactly at 18:00 EAT on the 2nd day prior to polling day.
